description: Says what controls what on a page, from its control links: each switch, dimmer or push button with the lights and sockets it controls, and through which of its ports; the objects that need control and have none (lights no switch turns on), under "uncontrolled"; and those that control nothing, under "idle". It describes the plan, it does not check an installation against any rule.

page.description: Id of a page or component. Leave it out for the one being worked on.

name: read_controls
